newsitem.title: INDIA: India's BPL group Co to raise $200 mln ADRs - paper.
newsitem.headline: India's BPL group Co to raise $200 mln ADRs - paper.

text.p: BPL Cellular Holding Ltd, part of India's BPL group, is raising $200 million though an issue of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), the Asian Age paper said on Wednesday.
The issue, to be listed on the NASDAQ, will have a greenshoe option of 15 percent and will be offered via SEC-registered initial public offering, it said.
The company has not yet received final (Indian government) clearance for the issue but was confident of getting it soon, the paper said.
Company officials were not immedietely available for comment.
The Asian Age quoted company sources as saying the funds raised through the issue would be utilised to build various telecommunications networks by BPL subsidiaries.
